Does Brad Pitt die in Growing Pains?

He plays Jeff / Jonathan Keith, a supporting role.

Want to guess first?

Revealing shows the answer, the scene, and a clip if we have one.

No. Sitcom heartthrob, twice over, never in danger.

In "Who's Zoomin' Who?" (November 1987) Pitt is Jeff, the cute transfer student Carol's friends push her toward. In "Feet of Clay" (February 1989) he plays Jonathan Keith, Ben's rock-star idol who turns out to be a jerk backstage. Both are family-sitcom guest spots; nobody dies.

Two different characters across two seasons.
